reason: Two identical charges on the same day is explicitly flagged in the billing FAQ as a billing error that must be escalated rather than resolved by the agent, and any related refund cannot be promised by a first-line agent.
reply:
Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the trouble. A duplicate charge for the exact same amount on the same day isn't expected behavior — normally, two charges in one day would only happen if a prorated charge (e.g., from crossing a member-count threshold) hit alongside a renewal, and those would show as separate line items with different amounts on your invoice.

Could you confirm what you see under Settings > Billing > Invoices for today — specifically whether both charges show as identical line items? In the meantime, I'm escalating this to our billing team so a human can review your account and correct the duplicate charge if confirmed. We'll follow up as soon as we have an update — we won't be able to process any refund or reversal ourselves, but our team will take care of it directly.
